title: Godot 4.4 local renderingDevice fails to be made on release build (.net)
body:
### Tested versions

tested with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta.mono (93d270693) - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (nvidia; 560.35.03) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700HQ CPU @ 2.80GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

trying to create a local renderingDevice gives the following error when ran from a release export, but works fine on an editor build:
```
ERROR: System.TypeInitializationException: The type initializer for 'Godot.RenderingDevice' threw an exception.
 ---> Godot.GodotObject+NativeMethodBindNotFoundException: Unable to find the native method bind. (Method 'RenderingDevice.vertex_buffer_create')
   at Godot.GodotObject.ClassDB_get_method_with_compatibility(StringName type, StringName method, UInt64 hash)
   at Godot.RenderingDevice..cctor()
   --- End of inner exception stack trace ---
   at Godot.RenderingDevice..ctor(IntPtr ptr)
   at Godot.Constructors.<>c.<.cctor>b__2_552(IntPtr ptr)
   at Godot.Constructors.Invoke(String nativeTypeNameStr, IntPtr nativeObjectPtr)
   at Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.CreateManagedForGodotObjectBinding(godot_string_name* nativeTypeName, IntPtr godotObject)
   at: void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (:0)
ERROR: Parameter "strong_gchandle.value" is null.
   at: setup_csharp_script_binding (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1155)
ERROR: Condition "!script_binding.inited" is true. Returning: { nullptr }
   at: godotsharp_internal_unmanaged_get_instance_binding_managed (modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:245)
ERROR: System.TypeInitializationException: The type initializer for 'Godot.RenderingDevice' threw an exception.
 ---> Godot.GodotObject+NativeMethodBindNotFoundException: Unable to find the native method bind. (Method 'RenderingDevice.vertex_buffer_create')
   at Godot.GodotObject.ClassDB_get_method_with_compatibility(StringName type, StringName method, UInt64 hash)
   at Godot.RenderingDevice..cctor()
   --- End of inner exception stack trace ---
   at Godot.RenderingDevice..ctor(IntPtr ptr)
   at Godot.Constructors.<>c.<.cctor>b__2_552(IntPtr ptr)
   at Godot.Constructors.Invoke(String nativeTypeNameStr, IntPtr nativeObjectPtr)
   at Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.CreateManagedForGodotObjectBinding(godot_string_name* nativeTypeName, IntPtr godotObject)
   at: void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (:0)
ERROR: Parameter "strong_gchandle.value" is null.
   at: setup_csharp_script_binding (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1155)
ERROR: Condition "!script_binding.inited" is true. Returning: { nullptr }
   at: godotsharp_internal_unmanaged_instance_binding_create_managed (modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:258)
```

### Steps to reproduce

create a project and in a c# script somewhere (that will be ran) put var rd = RenderingServer.CreateLocalRenderingDevice();

then export a release build and try running it from a terminal to see the error

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/hpf3/godot-Bug
